text: I will read a poem, when I pause you may recite back what I said as accurately as possible. After you recite it back, we will continue to the next verse, until the poem is finished.
The first poem is “Invention” by Billy Collins. Ready? Here we go!
and in a week or so,
and nine, maybe ten days ago
by the end of the month,
it will waste away to nothing,
nothing but stars in the sky,
We will now recite another poem, called “The Moment” by Margaret Atwood
the trees unloose their soft arms
the birds take back their language,
No, they whisper. You own nothing.
time after time climbing the hill,
It was always the other way round.
We will now recite another poem, called “Stopping by woods on a snowy evening” by Robert Frost
He gives his harness bells a shake.
The only other sound’s the sweep.
But I have promises to keep,
And miles to go before I sleep
And miles to go before I sleep.
